Which of the three Woodsboro Murders (1996, 2011, 2022) had the highest body count?
questions.endnote: The 2011 Woodsboro Murders had a total of 9 fatalities while the 1996 and 2022 Woodsboro Murders each had 6 fatalities, respectively

questions.question: In total, how many characters have survived an attack in a previous Woodsboro Murder spree only to die in a later one?
questions.endnote: Dwight "Dewey" Riley survived in 1996 and 2011 but died in 2022. Judy Hicks survived in 2011 but died in 2022.
